title: ChatWeave Message (draft 0.1)
description: DRAFT. A chat message as persisted by the host and synced to clients: an ordered list of content blocks plus a mandatory plain-text fallback. After reconnect or offline, the persisted message (higher rev) always wins over a locally assembled stream state.

id.description: Message id. User messages: generated by the sending client (UUIDv7 recommended), doubling as the idempotency key for offline queues and retries; the server validates and adopts it unchanged, and the optimistic local copy is reconciled by this same id. Assistant / system messages: server-generated only.

status.description: streaming: still being produced. complete: finished normally. interrupted: producer stopped early (crash, cancel, upstream failure); content so far is kept. error: nothing usable was produced; fallbackText explains.

fallbackText.description: Whole-message plain text. Always present, also for status 'error'. Markdown-only clients render just this.

rev.description: Persisted revision. 1 when the message is first completed; +1 for every later change (e.g. a choice block resolved).

metadata.description: Opaque host data (e.g. trace ids). Never rendered by the library.

view.description: RESERVED for the Phase 2 View protocol (layout planning that references block data by id). Must not be emitted in 0.1; clients ignore it.

allOf.$comment: Client-generated user message ids double as idempotency keys, so they must be long enough to be unique (same rule as action ids). The former separate clientMessageId field was removed (see decisions D43).
